race.comment: CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (6) is racing very well with placings at his last two starts including a second last time over 2080m at Cranbourne, beaten 1.5 metres after travelling in a forward position and leading the field into the lane. His recent form is good enough to take out a race like this. MYDEEPESTDESIRE (7) has been racing without luck. Was commendable in defeat last time out when third over 1700m at Horsham. Tactics will be crucial from this wide draw. Meets a comparable field and she can play a major role. AMADA VILLMA (9) found one better two runs back then made mistakes last time when she broke and finished 16 metres back in fifth over 1690m at Shepparton. Must get things right but if she does a big run is on the cards. Sweet Lou filly JAZZY LOU (2) draws well and is worth keeping safe on debut.
